_meta.name: PersonSwap identity ref cut-out (white plate)
_meta.notes: One cheap pass per identity ref, run once per job before the VACE windows: BiRefNet RemoveBackground returns the subject MASK, the mask's inverse is rendered by MaskToImage as the WHITE destination plate, and ImageCompositeMasked pastes the subject onto it — a clean white-background cut-out. VACE's reference_image encoder keys identity much more reliably off a cut-out than off a busy scene photo. The recipe re-uploads the cut-out and feeds it as the person graph's REF_IMAGE(n). OF_MatteCoverage on the matte emits a 1x1 coverage strip so the recipe can rank refs — the best 3 by matte coverage drive the swap when more than 3 photos come in.
